scientific_integrity.checks: The standalone standard-library verification script ran 467463 exact integer assertions; its finite range is disclosed.
proof_dependencies: Bóna and Mező (2007) Theorem 1 (real-rootedness, interlacing of nonsingleton partition polynomials)
scientific_integrity.proven_statement: All second-order minors of the exact joint count array of total blocks and singleton blocks are nonnegative for every finite set size at least two, with strict conditional stochastic ordering and strict increasing-transform covariance.

scientific_limitations: The infinite theorem relies on the previously published Bóna–Mező exact root-interlacing theorem.
The total positivity and likelihood-ratio conclusions are for singleton blocks, fixed labeled-set size, and optional positive tilts of the total number of blocks.
Historical originality is qualified because implicit results in other total-positivity or occupancy literature cannot be excluded.
Finite computational checks corroborate but do not prove the unbounded-size statement.
title: Likelihood-ratio ordering of singleton abundance in uniform set partitions
